g.text: A20 | Gene-level patterns separate niche RNA from matrix RNA
Each colored point is one paired source sample (n=5). Black tick: median; grey line: observed range, not a confidence interval.
Same day-42 samples as F1. RNA abundance does not measure secretion, deposited matrix, or mature epithelial output.
